programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Saat Chang Sun memberikan tumpangan pada Wen Jou yang tengah tersesat, ia langsung jatuh cinta. Namun, Chang harus memperjuangkan cintanya karena kakak Wen, seorang gangster bernama Wen Chiang, tidak menyukainya.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: 72 penghuni rumah petak nan kumuh hidup di bawah pengawasan pemilik rumah yang tak berperasaan dan suami jahatnya. Namun, kedatangan seorang penyewa baru nan berani, mengubah nasib mereka.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Dua teman masa kecil di sebuah komunitas terpencil bersumpah untuk hidup bersaudara selamanya. Peristiwa tragis pun dimulai ketika beberapa tahun kemudian salah seorang dari mereka ingin menikah.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets

programme.title: Pursuit Of Vengeance
programme.desc: Legenda Kung Fu Ti Lung membintangi film laga ini sebagai Fu Xue Hong, yang memulai perjalanan agar dapat membalas dendam untuk ayahnya.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Musik dan keajaiban dari The Singing Escort menjadi ajang untuk menampilkan daya tarik Betty Ting. Ting berperan sebagai Susan, seorang wanita muda yang bersembunyi dari ayahnya.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-An
programme.desc: Kaisar Han meninggal dan Permaisuri Lu merebut alih kekuasaan. Ia merencanakan untuk membunuh pewaris takhta, Liu Heng. Namun, prajurit bertopeng mengetahui rencana jahatnya dan memberi tahu Liu.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang menulis dan menyutradarai Tales of Larceny, kisah tentang tipu muslihat dan permainan licik di era panglima perang Tiongkok yang korup, dibintangi aktor-aktor karakter terbaik dari Shaw Brothers.

programme.title: Godfather Of Canton
programme.desc: Seorang komisaris ditangkap oleh utusan Cheng atas tuduhan korupsi dengan bantuan yang tak disengaja dari Lin. Saat bekerja untuk Cheng, Lin akhirnya mengetahui cara memperoleh uang suap dari Chang.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Peter Chen Ho adalah seorang playboy tampan yang mengencani tiga gadis kakak beradik, dan hal ini memicu serangkaian peristiwa konyol dan menghebohkan.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam diburu saat mengetahui bahwa walikota dan kepala biro medis bersekongkol dengan seorang pengedar narkoba. Ia melarikan diri ke Shaolin untuk mempelajari kung fu demi membalaskan dendam teman-temannya.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: Tiga gadis pergi ke Jepang untuk mengambil warisan yang tak terduga dan bertemu tiga pria dengan niat yang sama. Pertarungan sengit pun terjadi untuk memperebutkan warisan tersebut.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Film sekuel ini bercerita tentang imigran Yeh Feng yang kabur dari penjara untuk tinggal bersama paman Wang Sha yang jahat. Namun, ternyata kekasihnya, Ai Ti, telah menikah dengan seorang pria yang kasar.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Ketua Pengadilan Chan Koon Tai sungguh berdedikasi. Loyalitasnya yang berlebihan membuatnya mengejar seorang pencuri sadis yang bertekad untuk menghabisi anak buah Chan.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Tiga pendekar kung fu dari latar belakang yang sangat berbeda menjadi murid Shaolin di kuil yang sama: Lo Lieh sang Pengawal Kerajaan, Lo Meng sang tentara yang melarikan diri, dan Wang Yu si pria desa.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing dan Huang Rong mengasuh putra saudara angkatnya Yang Kang dan memberinya nama Yang Gou. Demi mencegah Yan Gou membalas dendam atas kematian ayahnya, Huang Rong melarangnya mempelajari seni bela diri.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Seorang playboy kaya tewas akibat diledakkan oleh seorang gangster ketika ia menggoda istri gangster tersebut. Melalui serangkaian kejadian, profesornya membuatkan tubuh sintetis yang memungkinkannya untuk berubah menjadi apa pun yang diinginkannya.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Berlatar belakang tahun-tahun awal Republik Tiongkok, keluarga Kang yang kaya dibunuh secara brutal, dan putri kecil mereka satu-satunya saksi menghilang secara misterius.

programme.title: The Fate Of Reunion
programme.desc: Siluman Ular Hijau memperoleh pencerahan di bawah bimbingan Dao Qing dan perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, pengabdiannya pada Dao Qing membuatnya bereinkarnasi dan mengalami rasa sakit akibat kematian.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei mengalami gangguan pascatrauma usai kematian istrinya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Amy yang bekerja di perusahaan teknologi VR dan diundang untuk menguji produk baru. Ia pun menjadi petarung VR perusahaan itu.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Monyet Batu, memberikan harapan kepada seorang gadis kecil nan putus asa. Namun, Monyet Batu dikalahkan dalam pertempuran melawan Dewa Perang bermata tiga, yang membuatnya kehilangan kekuatan dan jatuh ke dunia fana.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back

programme.title: Tom's Midnight Garden
programme.desc: Seorang anak lelaki melakukan perjalanan melintasi batas-batas realitas menuju suatu tempat rahasia dan berhantu, setengah abad yang lalu, dalam kisah penuh pesona, bayangan, dan kenangan yang hilang ini.

programme.title: Daughter For Sale
programme.desc: Daughter for Sale mengisahkan Rachel, seorang ibu yang hidupnya berubah ketika putrinya yang masih remaja tiba-tiba menghilang. Tidak percaya bahwa putrinya pergi begitu saja, Rachel melakukan penyelidikan sendiri untuk mencari kebenaran. Dalam pencariannya, ia menemukan adanya jaringan eksploitasi dan perdagangan manusia yang mengancam banyak korban. Dengan keberanian dan tekad yang kuat, Rachel berusaha menyelamatkan putrinya sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: Undercover Files: Betrayal
programme.desc: Undercover Files: Betrayal mengungkap kasus nyata tentang penipuan dan pengkhianatan, menelusuri rahasia tersembunyi serta berbagai rencana berbahaya melalui investigasi, wawancara, dan kisah dramatis.

programme.title: Santa Claws
programme.desc: Tommy membiarkan anak-anak kucingnya untuk dibawa Santa ke Kutub Utara. Namun, setelah Santa mengalami reaksi alergi parah, ia tidak bisa lagi mengantarkan hadiah. Akhirnya, anak-anak kucing tersebut harus mengantarkan sisa hadiah kepada semua anak laki-laki dan perempuan.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: Seorang penipu yang berusaha naik dari pekerja karnaval rendahan menjadi medium paranormal terkenal harus adu kecerdikan dengan seorang psikolog yang bertekad membongkar tipu dayanya.

programme.title: Lost Outlaw
programme.desc: Sebuah kamp penambangan emas di Tiongkok diserbu oleh sekelompok penjahat. Salah satu penjahat tersebut harus mempertanyakan moralnya setelah bertemu dengan wanita impiannya.

programme.title: Mary 4 Mayor
programme.desc: Dalam pencalonannya sebagai walikota melawan ayahnya yang menjabat sebagai walikota saat ini, seorang wanita muda berusia delapan belas tahun mempelajari pelajaran hidup berharga yang tidak hanya menjadi landasan untuk menyelamatkan keluarganya, tetapi juga kota tempat dia tinggal.

programme.title: Hero Dog: The Journey Home
programme.desc: Terpisah dari keluarga akibat sebuah kejadian yang tak terduga, seekor anjing setia berjuang menempuh perjalanan panjang untuk menemukan jalan pulang. Di tengah medan yang penuh tantangan, ia menghadapi berbagai bahaya, bertemu orang-orang yang membantunya, serta menunjukkan keberanian dan kesetiaan yang luar biasa. Hero Dog: The Journey Home menghadirkan kisah petualangan keluarga yang hangat tentang arti persahabatan, harapan, dan ikatan istimewa antara manusia dan sahabat berkaki empatnya.

programme.title: Wake Of Death
programme.desc: Setelah istrinya dibunuh secara kejam, Ben Archer, seorang penegak hukum di klub, melancarkan perang melawan sindikat Tionghoa.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Di sebuah kota futuristik di masa depan, seorang hakim, juri, sekaligus algojo bernama Dredd berupaya untuk membasmi kejahatan.

programme.title: Deadly Vendetta
programme.desc: Ketika seorang petugas pemasyarakatan ditemukan tewas di apartemennya, polisi menduga apakah seorang mantan narapidana membalas dendam padanya; namun, segera terungkap bahwa pembunuhan tersebut mungkin tidak terkait dengan pekerjaannya, setelah polisi mengungkap keterlibatan korban dalam segitiga cinta yang berbahaya

programme.desc: Frikke, seorang anak laki-laki berusia 14 tahun, menemukan sebuah permainan komputer jahat yang menggunakan anak-anak sungguhan dari lingkungannya sebagai pemain. Dalam perlombaan melawan waktu, Frikke harus menemukan pencipta jahat dari permainan mengerikan ini.

programme.desc: Setelah ditanami mikrochip yang memberinya kekuatan khusus, seekor anjing terlibat dalam percakapan dan petualangan dengan seorang anak laki-laki. Fahri yang melihat kecantikan Nadia, semakin kagum. Tanpa Nadia sadari, sebenarnya Fahri menyukai Nadia. Melihat Fahri yang terpesona, Nadia bilang Fahri tidak boleh jatuh cinta kepada Nadia.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Apapun Masalah Cintamu, Damkar Solusinya

programme.desc: Pada suatu hari tanpa sengaja Intan bertemu dengan seorang pria bernama Yoga yang mengalami kecelakaan karena dipukuli. Intan langsung membawa pria tersebut ke rumah sakit, tapi ternyata Yoga mengalami amnesia akibat benturan kencang yang dideritanya. Sahabat Intan memberikan ide bagaimana agar Intan berpura-pura menjadi calon istrinya Yoga.

programme.title: Kelinci Emang Lucu Tapi Kamu Yang Bikin Misyu
programme.desc: Sebelumnya, Nila adalah seorang anak orang kaya raya bernama Rudi, tapi tidak lama perusahaan Rusdi gulung tikar. Nila dan Rusdi terpaksa keluar dari rumah mewah mereka dan memutuskan untuk kembali ke desa sebab di sana masih ada harta Rusdi berupa perkebunan sayur. Setibanya di kebun sayur, Nila bertemu dengan kelinci milik Damar yang lucu. Nila dan Damar pun berkenalan. Mengetahui Nila adalah anak Rusdi, Damar marah.

programme.title: Temple
programme.desc: Tiga turis Amerika mengikuti sebuah peta misterius masuk ke dalam hutan di Jepang demi mencari sebuah kuil kuno. Saat sesosok arwah menjebak mereka, perjalanan mereka pun berubah menjadi mimpi buruk nan mengerikan.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: Seorang detektif swasta harus mengungkap pembunuhan pamannya sambil menjaga rahasia bahwa dia adalah keturunan manusia serigala.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: Angkatan Laut Jerman dan kapal-kapal U-Boat yang tersisa bergabung untuk satu misi terakhir guna menyerang Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: Angkatan Laut Jerman dan kapal-kapal U-Boat yang tersisa bergabung untuk satu misi terakhir guna menyerang Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: Di Barat yang tak ada aturan hukum, The Cowboys, kakak-beradik pembunuh dan pencuri nan terkenal, menguasai wilayah tersebut dengan tinju brutal dan senjata api. Namun, takdir akhirnya datang menghampiri mereka.

programme.title: The Ballad Of Davy Crockett
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1815, seorang Legenda Amerika, yang istrinya jatuh sakit parah, meninggalkan anak-anaknya yang masih kecil untuk bertahan hidup sendirian, harus berjuang untuk kembali menemui mereka melewati banyak bahaya yang ditemukan di Savage Lands di daerah perbatasan yang liar.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Berlatar saat Perang Dunia II, sekelompok tentara Angkatan Darat Amerika dikirim dalam misi rahasia untuk menemukan komandan mereka yang hilang.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1876, seorang pemburu bayaran melacak saudaranya sendiri di seluruh Montana dengan bantuan seorang pemburu hewan ilegal.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: Setelah mengamati hasil pemindaian CAT abnormal yang sangat familiar pada seorang gadis berusia 13 tahun, ahli radiologi Nina Evanko berjuang untuk menemukan sumber gangguan tidur yang dialami gadis muda itu. Apa yang ia temukan lebih gelap dan aneh dari yang dapat ia bayangkan.

programme.title: Candy Land
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda yang tampak naif dan taat beragama memasuki dunia bawah tanah pekerja seks di tempat peristirahatan truk, yang juga dikenal sebagai "lot lizards."

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
Havenhurst
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda nan bermasalah tinggal di sebuah apartemen tua tempat ia harus menghadapi sesosok iblis yang mengerikan.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: Seorang petani menampung seorang pria yang terluka dengan tas berisi uang tunai. Ketika sekelompok orang datang untuk mengambil uang itu, dia harus memutuskan siapa yang bisa dipercaya. Saat mempertahankan diri dari pengepungan, dia mengungkapkan bakatnya sebagai penembak jitu yang membuat identitas aslinya dipertanyakan.

programme.title: The Pig Farmer
programme.desc: Investigasi pemenang penghargaan atas kejahatan Robert Pickton. Film dokumenter ini mengeksplorasi mengapa butuh bertahun-tahun untuk menangkap dan menghukum pembunuh berantai paling produktif di Kanada. Pengungkapan yang meresahkan tentang siapa yang tahu apa, dan kapan.

programme.title: Bad Boys For Life (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Sepasang detektif Miami, Mike Lowrey dan Marcus Burnett, harus menghadapi bandar narkoba ibu dan anak yang membuat kegaduhan di kota mereka.

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Orang-orang bersenjata membajak kereta bawah tanah Kota New York, menyandera penumpang dengan imbalan uang tebusan, dan mengubah pekerjaan sehari-hari petugas operator Walter Garber menjadi pertarungan dengan dalang di balik kejahatan tersebut.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Gembong narkoba yang dipenjara menawarkan hadiah uang tunai dalam jumlah besar bagi siapa saja yang dapat membebaskannya dari tahanan polisi, dan hanya tim Senjata dan Taktik Khusus L.A.P.D. yang dapat mencegahnya.

programme.title: The One
programme.desc: Seorang agen ditugasi mengamati sejumlah dunia alternatif kala sosok lain dirinya nan jahat mulai membunuh beberapa duplikat dirinya yang lain agar menjadi Sang Tunggal. Bentrokan antardunia paralel pun terjadi.

programme.title: The Rundown
programme.desc: Seorang calon koki yang tangguh disewa untuk membawa pulang putra seorang mafia dari Amazon, tetapi malah terlibat dalam perjuangan melawan penguasa kota yang menindas dan pencarian harta karun legendaris.

programme.title: The Rundown
programme.desc: Seorang calon koki yang tangguh disewa untuk membawa pulang putra seorang mafia dari Amazon, tetapi malah terlibat dalam perjuangan melawan penguasa kota yang menindas dan pencarian harta karun legendaris.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: Mary adalah seorang pembunuh bayaran yang bekerja untuk sebuah keluarga kejahatan terorganisir di Boston, yang hidupnya berubah total ketika dia bertemu dengan seorang anak laki-laki yang secara tak sengaja berpapasan dengannya saat sebuah misi pembunuhan profesional gagal.

programme.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure
programme.desc: Dua bersaudara ditarik ke dalam petualangan intergalaksi ketika rumah mereka terlempar ke luar angkasa oleh permainan papan ajaib yang mereka mainkan.

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Dua detektif mendapat kesempatan untuk beraksi seperti polisi terkenal yang selalu mereka kagumi, tetapi situasi tidak selalu berjalan seperti yang direncanakan.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: John bekerja dengan polisi PreCrime yang menghentikan kejahatan sebelum terjadi, dengan bantuan tiga 'PreCogs' yang dapat meramalkan kejahatan. Berbagai peristiwa terjadi ketika John mendapati dirinya dijebak untuk sebuah pembunuhan di masa depan.

programme.desc: Frasier Season 7 mengikuti kehidupan Dr. Frasier Crane, seorang psikiater yang bekerja sebagai penyiar radio, saat menghadapi berbagai masalah dalam pekerjaan, keluarga, persahabatan, dan hubungan asmara. Bersama saudaranya Niles, ayahnya Martin, Daphne, dan Roz, Frasier menghadapi berbagai situasi kocak seputar cinta, pernikahan, pekerjaan, konflik keluarga, dan usahanya mengendalikan kehidupan yang semakin rumit.

programme.title: CSI S7, Ep 9
programme.desc: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation Season 7 mengikuti Gil Grissom dan tim investigator forensiknya saat memeriksa bukti serta menyelidiki berbagai kasus kriminal di Las Vegas. Dengan menggabungkan analisis ilmiah, pengamatan yang teliti, dan pengalaman investigasi, mereka berusaha merekonstruksi kejadian, menemukan tersangka, dan mengungkap kebenaran di balik setiap kasus.

Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.desc: Gambar apa yang akan diposkan Pororo dan teman-temannya di Postagram? Lihat semua foto dan lihat kembali semua kenangan indah bersama.

programme.title: Cocomelon English
programme.desc: Pelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, dan lainnya dengan JJ dalam serial musik yang menghadirkan saat-saat menyenangkan dengan sajak anak-anak untuk seluruh keluarga

programme.title: Poyo Show
programme.desc: Rasakan kisah Pororo, Tayo dan Tittipo! Hari ini, apa yang akan terjadi pada teman-teman kita?

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Pororo Season 7
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. programme.title: Sorotan Utama
programme.desc: Sorotan Utama di Sin Po TV adalah program diskusi yang menganalisis isu-isu krusial di Indonesia secara mendalam. Berbeda dari berita biasa, program ini menggali akar masalah, implikasi, dan berbagai perspektif dari para ahli. Setiap episode membahas topik utama seperti kebijakan pemerintah, politik, ekonomi, sosial, atau budaya. Dengan menghadirkan narasumber kredibel, Sorotan Utama bertujuan membantu pemirsa memahami kompleksitas isu dan membentuk opini yang terinformasi. Program ini ideal bagi siapa saja yang ingin mendapatkan pemahaman lebih dalam tentang dinamika yang memengaruhi Indonesia.

programme.title: Ruang Kabinet
programme.desc: RUANG KABINET di Sin Po TV adalah program khusus yang menyajikan liputan eksklusif dan mendalam tentang kegiatan dan agenda resmi para menteri Kabinet Indonesia Maju. Acara ini memberikan gambaran komprehensif mengenai kinerja dan kebijakan pemerintah. Setiap episode menyoroti pertemuan antar-kementerian, kunjungan kerja, peresmian program, hingga rapat kabinet, menggali makna, tujuan, dan implikasi setiap aktivitas terhadap pembangunan negara dan masyarakat. Dengan akses langsung dan liputan detail, CABINET ACTIVITY bertujuan mendekatkan pemirsa dengan kinerja pemerintahan dan meningkatkan pemahaman publik mengenai peran setiap kementerian dalam menjalankan program strategis nasional, relevan bagi siapa pun yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan kebijakan pemerintah.

But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. Instead, they find a 50-foot boa constrictor.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Charlie's Farm
programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

Funny stories will help seeing classic stories from the new side and prove that world classic literature is exciting and interesting.

When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: Spine Tingler: The William Castle Story
programme.desc: Throughout the 1950's and 60's, William Castle produced and directed horror films marked by their outrageous gimmicks. This documentary is about his rags-to-riches tale of exploitation and self-promotion, yet a man privately plagued by a fear of failure.

programme.title: You Never Know
programme.desc: Immersed in a world filled with crime, drugs and betrayal, a group of friends have a tough time dealing with the daily pressures of life. With the support of one another, they come up with a plan to overcome their reality.

programme.title: Killing Zelda Sparks
programme.desc: Two old high-school buddies, Craig Blackshear and Terry Seville decide to pull a vicious prank on Craig's meddling former girlfriend Zelda, but Terry is appalled to learn that the prank may have taken a deadly turn.

programme.title: Reflections on the Living Dead
programme.desc: Director George A. Romero, co-writer John A. Russo, and producers Russell W. Streiner and Karl Hardman gather for the first time in 25 years for a once-in-a-lifetime roundtable discussion on the making of "Night of the Living Dead."

programme.title: Exegesis Lovecraft
programme.desc: A documentary following a filmmaker as he traces the life of H.P. Lovecraft, from woodland cemeteries in Rhode Island to the docks of New York and the streets of Quebec City. A film that proves that the truth is weirder than fiction.

programme.title: Locker 13
programme.desc: Skip delves into the mysteries of an old creepy locker. His sage supervisor recounts 4 chilling cautionary tales to warn Skip, and the stories come into play when Skip faces a life-or-death decision of his own. A Twilight Zone style thriller.

programme.title: Chariot
programme.desc: Seven strangers wake aboard a passenger jet, with no idea how they got there or where they are headed. CHARIOT is a twisty, claustrophobic thriller with eerie parallels to today's news headlines. Starring Anthony Montgomery ("Star Trek: Enterprise").

programme.title: You Never Know
programme.desc: Immersed in a world filled with crime, drugs and betrayal, a group of friends have a tough time dealing with the daily pressures of life. With the support of one another, they come up with a plan to overcome their reality.

programme.title: Rehabilitation of the Hill
programme.desc: The battle over an urban neighborhood gets personal when the wealthy heiress of a mogul developer hides her identity, accidentally falling in love with a local community organizer while stealing the community's plans for herself.

programme.title: Kung Fu Brother
programme.desc: Three cops and a reporter pursue a murderer who's hellbent on acquiring sacred scrolls. As they chase the murderer far and wide, they must find a way to take him down before he gets his hands on the scrolls.

programme.title: Love You Right: An R&B Musical
programme.desc: When a series of events causes Will Clay's career as a successful R&B artist to hit rock bottom, he is forced to heal and come to grips with lessons on loyalty and love.

programme.title: Alpha Rift
programme.desc: When a magic helmet thrusts Nolan Parthmore into a world of modern-day knights fighting supernatural evil, he's forced to become the hero he was destined to be.

programme.title: Senn
programme.desc: Charles Dickens meets Arthur C. Clarke-A lowly factory worker is delivered from a world of misery and discovers his destiny via an ancient object on the other side of the stars.

programme.title: Nothing in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Quinn is a writer dating Ann, a woman twice his age. His best friend Peter is married to Beth but having a bit of a sexual identity crisis. When a connection sparks between Quinn and Beth, it makes all four reevaluate what love means to them.

programme.title: Pushing Dead
programme.desc: Dan's been HIV positive for 22 years. He's got his $3,000-a-month pill regimen down, but when he deposits a $100 birthday check and suddenly doesn't qualify for his assisted healthcare plan, he's got to scramble to get his life together or risk losing it.

programme.title: You Never Know
programme.desc: Immersed in a world filled with crime, drugs and betrayal, a group of friends have a tough time dealing with the daily pressures of life. With the support of one another, they come up with a plan to overcome their reality.

programme.title: The Man in the Trunk
programme.desc: When an absent friend asks a Lawyer to leave with him in the middle of the night with no questions asked, he must confront the consequences of true friendship. Who is the man in the trunk?

programme.title: Antisocial 2
programme.desc: Years after having her newborn child stolen from her, Sam searches a world infested with infected users from the Social Redroom website.

programme.title: The Subjects
programme.desc: Eight strangers go into a locked room for clinical trials on a new drug that gives them superpowers.

programme.title: Raising Flagg
programme.desc: Flagg Purdy (Alan Arkin) is a lovable but stubborn man. When he escalates a minor disagreement with his oldest friend into a legal battle, he incurs the wrath of his neighbors and friends.

programme.title: Mop King
programme.desc: Jed is a freelance maid struggling to maintain his slacker man-child lifestyle. While his disappointed parents' vacation to Maui without him, he meets a vulgar drifter girl who becomes his companion on a journey of maid mayhem.

programme.title: Down in the Valley
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, a teenage girl named Tobe meets a charismatic stranger named Harlan, who dresses like a cowboy and claims to be a former ranch hand. The pair feel an instant attraction and begin a relationship, but her father, a lawman, is suspicious of her lover.

programme.title: My Dinner With Andre
programme.desc: Old friends Wallace (Wallace Shawn) and Andre (Andre Gregory) haven't seen each another in five years and agree to meet for dinner. Andre, a once well-known theater director, dropped out of the New York scene to travel the world, while Wallace stuck around, finding only mixed success as a playwright. As they sit down to eat, Andre launches into a series of fantastic stories from his time away, and Wallace can't help but notice how different their worldviews have become.

programme.title: The Brood
programme.desc: Mad psychopathic therapist (Oliver Reed) treats raging woman (Samantha Eggar).

programme.title: The Ticket
programme.desc: After James, a blind man, inexplicably regains his vision, he becomes possessed by a drive to make a better life for himself. However, his new improvements -- a nicer home, a higher paying job, tailored suits, luxury car -- leave little room for the people who were part of his old, simpler life. As his relationships buckle under the strain of his snowballing ambition, it becomes uncertain if James can ever return from darkness.

programme.title: JCVD
programme.desc: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

programme.title: The Gambler V: Playing for Keeps
programme.desc: Cardsharp Brady Hawkes searches for his son, who is on the run with outlaws Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men
programme.desc: A fighter vows not to speak until he finds the masked man who killed his father.

programme.title: 10th and Wolf
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: New father Frank (Emilio Estevez) departs for a night out, joining friends Mike (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and Ray (Jeremy Piven) as they head to a boxing match. At the last minute, they are joined by John (Stephen Dorff), Frank's brother. Stuck in gridlock traffic, the guys take a shortcut that gets them lost. In a very dangerous neighborhood, they witness a murder by a gang leader called Fallon (Denis Leary). They flee, but Fallon now wants them hunted down and eliminated.

programme.title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
programme.desc: Called to a French monastery following the appearance of a dead body, Detective Pierre Niemans (Jean Reno) finds himself investigating what appears to be a radical cult killing that's based on obscure passages from the Bible. When fellow detective Reda (Benoît Magimel) shows up, his own murder investigation intertwining with Niemans', it becomes clear that a grand conspiracy is underway, one that spans the globe and reaches all the way back to World War II.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Derailed
programme.desc: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus.

programme.title: Blind Dating
programme.desc: Danny (Chris Pine) is a blind man who does not let his impairment get in the way of living his life to the fullest, except when it comes to love. Danny's brother (Eddie Kaye Thomas) sets him up on a series of blind dates, but all of them go disastrously wrong. Just when Danny is about to give up, he meets Leeza (Anjali Jay), a nurse who works for Danny's doctor. There is just one catch: Leeza, who is from India, is promised to another man.

programme.title: A Boy and His Dog
programme.desc: Vic is a libidinous 18-year-old traversing the post-apocalyptic desert of 2024, in the company of his telepathic dog, Blood. When the pair encounter an underground community, the leader's daughter, Quilla Holmes, seduces Vic into their fold, separating him from Blood, who's left to survive on his own. But once Vic discovers he's been lured there solely for mechanized procreation, he realizes he's doomed unless he can escape and rejoin Blood.

programme.title: Creepshow 2
programme.desc: This second horror anthology presents more eerie tales based on Stephen King stories. One episode finds a cigar-store Native American statue coming to life to avenge the death of the shop owner (George Kennedy) and his wife (Dorothy Lamour). Another features a group of teens menaced by a blob-like creature. The final installment follows a wealthy and callous woman (Lois Chiles) who hits a hitchhiker with her car and decides to flee the scene, but the victim isn't inclined to remain dead.

programme.title: Foreign Correspondent
programme.desc: Crime reporter John Jones (Joel McCrea) is turning in nothing but dull copy. His editor, unhappy with his work, hopes a change of scenery will be the thing Jones needs to get back on track. Re-assigned to Europe as a foreign correspondent, Jones is very much out of his element. When he stumbles on a spy ring, he feels ill-equipped to unravel the truth alone, and he seeks help from a beautiful politician's daughter (Laraine Day) and an urbane English journalist (George Sanders).

programme.title: Space Truckers
programme.desc: A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.

programme.title: Dog Soldiers
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
programme.desc: Newly released from a mental institution, Ricky (Antonio Banderas) heads straight for a reunion with the love of his life, B-movie actress Marina (Victoria Abril). The trouble is, Marina doesn't remember him -- or the fling they had during her years as a junkie and porn star. Determined to make Marina love him, Ricky barges into her apartment and ties her up. With a captive audience, Ricky is sure it's only a matter of time before his beloved returns his affections.

programme.title: Sharktopus vs. Whalewolf
programme.desc: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a hybrid of a killer whale and a wolf.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teen-age Witch
programme.desc: The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.

programme.title: Squadron 303: The Battle of Britain
programme.desc: Polish fighter pilots defend the United Kingdom during the Battle of Britain.

programme.title: Jeffrey
programme.desc: Jeffrey (Steven Weber), a gay man living in New York City with an overwhelming fear of contracting AIDS, concludes that being celibate is the only option to protect himself. As fate would have it, shortly after his declaration of a sex-free existence, he meets the handsome Steve Howard (Michael T. Weiss), his dream man -- except for his HIV-positive status. Facing this dilemma, Jeffrey turns to his best friend (Patrick Stewart) and an outrageous priest (Nathan Lane) for guidance.

programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. programme.desc: Once an architect, Frank Bannister (Michael J. Fox) now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. To bolster his facade, he claims his "special" gift is the result of a car accident that killed his wife. But what he does not count on is more people dying in the small town where he lives. As he tries to piece together the supernatural mystery of these killings, he falls in love with the wife (Trini Alvarado) of one of the victims and deals with a crazy FBI agent (Jeffrey Combs).

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: On an Arctic expedition, Stanley Shepard discovers Charlie, a Neanderthal man frozen in ice. With a team of scientists, Shepard revives Charlie and learns that he has been cryogenically suspended for 40,000 years. Stanley grows close to Charlie as he observes the man and learns about his prehistoric culture -- but when the media catches on to the discovery, Stanley must protect Charlie from fellow scientists who want to use his corpse for scientific research.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: Chilling tale about a US research satellite carrying a deadly extraterrestrial microscopic organism that crashes into a small town in Arizona. A group of top scientists are hurriedly assembled in a bid to identify and contain the lethal stowaway. Based on the novel by Michael Crichton.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: The Purge: Anarchy
programme.desc: One night per year, the government sanctions a 12-hour period in which citizens can commit any crime they wish -- including murder -- without fear of punishment or imprisonment. Leo, a sergeant who lost his son, plans a vigilante mission of revenge during the mayhem. However, instead of a death-dealing avenger, he becomes the unexpected protector of four innocent strangers who desperately need his help if they are to survive the night.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: Grace and Jim are a pair of college students on their way to spring break in a 1970 Oldsmobile. Blissfully unaware of the horror that awaits them, they offer a ride to hitchhiker John Ryder, a killer who subsequently terrorizes the couple and implicates them in a grisly slaying.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Eric Bana ("Black Hawk Down") stars as scientist Bruce Banner, whose inner demons transform him in the aftermath of a catastrophic experiment; Jennifer Connelly portrays Betty Ross, whose scientific genius unwittingly helps unleash the Hulk; Nick Nolte plays Banner's brilliant father, who passes on a tragic legacy to his son; and Sam Elliott portrays the commander of a top-secret military research center.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Born in East L.A.
programme.desc: A Los Angeles native (Cheech Marin) is rounded up by mistake with illegal aliens and dumped south of the border.

programme.title: Slap Shot
programme.desc: In the small New England town of Charlestown, the local mill is about to lay off 10,000 workers. The town's minor league hockey team, the Charlestown Chiefs, is doing no better. After years of failure, this will be the team's last season. Exasperated player and coach Reggie Dunlop (Paul Newman) lets the club's recent acquisitions, the Hanson Brothers, play. The brothers' actively violent and thuggish style of play excites the fans. Dunlop retools the team, using violence to draw big crowds.

programme.title: For Love of the Game
programme.desc: Forty-year-old pitcher Billy Chapel (Kevin Costner) is practically a dinosaur by professional baseball standards, fast approaching the end of his career. But, as Chapel stands on the mound pitching the game of his life, his thoughts don't turn to his prized history in sports, but rather return again and again to his tumultuous relationship with Jane Aubrey (Kelly Preston), a single mom who has stood at his side through the good and the bad but is now on the verge of leaving him.

programme.title: The Babe
programme.desc: George Herman "Babe" Ruth (John Goodman) grows from a troubled boy who was sent to an orphanage to one of the most successful baseball players on record. Babe first becomes a power hitter and pitcher for the Boston Red Sox. After a falling-out with Red Sox owner Harry Frazee (Peter Donat), Babe is sold to the New York Yankees. He is idolized in New York, setting a record for home runs, as well as creating dramatic moments like hitting two homers for a sick boy in the hospital.

programme.title: The Best of Times
programme.desc: Married banker Jack Dundee (Robin Williams) has lived his life regretting a botched play he made in a high school football game. His friend Reno Hightower (Kurt Russell), who threw the pass that Jack dropped, is deeply in debt from operating his car garage. With Reno, Jack hatches a plan to reunite all the players from the old game and replay it, hoping that this time he can make amends. When the game eventually happens, Jack again finds himself at the center of a key play.

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island -- only to find that surviving the landing was just the beginning. When dangerous rebels take most of the passengers hostage, the only person Torrance can count on for help is Louis Gaspare, an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael MacCauley is on his daily commute home, which becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a plan is unfolding, and he is caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train.

programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: On Dec. 7, 1941, Japanese forces launch a devastating attack on Pearl Harbor, the U.S. naval base in Hawaii. Six months later, the Battle of Midway commences on June 4, 1942, as the Japanese navy once again plans a strike against American ships in the Pacific. For the next three days, the U.S. Navy and a squad of brave fighter pilots engage the enemy in one of the most important and decisive battles of World War II.

programme.title: The DUFF

Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: The Edge of Seventeen

programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.desc: The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. Each adventure is packed with laughter, creativity, and educational moments, making learning a joyful experience for kids.

programme.title: The Berry Big Harvest
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store. Soon Orange's store is overflowing with Berry Bitty Fruits & Veggies. It's the berry first time Orange has not been able to find a “place for everything” in her store.

programme.title: Room at the Top
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom. Grateful for the support and not wanting to dampen anyone's enthusiasm, Strawberry tells each of them yes (actually, more like not-no).

programme.title: Don't Forget the Leaves!
programme.desc: Sid and his friends investigate and discover that leaves are food for animals, they provide shade, and they help make nutrients so flowers and trees can grow!

programme.title: The Bug Club
programme.desc: Sid and his friends use their magnifying glasses and discover ants, rolie polies, and caterpillars around the playground.

programme.title: Sky's the Limit
programme.desc: When a storm causes a giant boulder to cut off Berry Bitty City's water supply, Strawberry and the girls face the possibility of having to move away from their homes. With the help of Mr. Longface Caterpillar, the girls set out on an adventure to save their town.

programme.title: Blippi's Great Green Adventure
programme.desc: In this special episode, Blippi celebrates Earth Day with his Great Green Adventure. Caring for the environment is one of our prime responsibilities and Blippi teaches children how by taking them on a puzzle-solving adventure.

programme.title: Starlight, Star Bright
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine! The girls and Berrykins rush to turn the Marketplace Café into a suitable performance area for a big star like Cherry Jam.

programme.title: Practice Makes Perfect
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community. Plum suggests that she teach music lessons Plum has always wanted to learn the drums, as it would enhance her ability to give dance lessons with live rhythmic accompaniment.

programme.title: Link into the VRAINS
programme.desc: n Den City, duels are held in the highly advanced VR world Link VRAINS, which is always under attack by the Knights of Hanoi. However, a hero named Playmaker has arrived to face the Knights, capturing a program they want called an Ignis.

programme.title: Seize the Wind!
programme.desc: Playmaker continues his duel with the Knight of Hanoi using the new Speed Duel rules. Playmaker is backed into a corner by the Knight's Cracking Dragon, but a data storm soon envelopes the field and Playmaker activates his Skill.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: Beasts And Dragons, Rise Of Garmadon

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.
